Compounding.description: How often interest is compounded within a year.

oneOf.description: Once a year: the rate is an effective annual rate.
Twice a year (nominal rate / 2 per half year).

Date.description: Calendar date, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD, from 1900-01-01 to 2199-12-31.

DatedCashFlow.description: An amount paid or received on a date.

amount.description: Amount in currency units; negative for payments, positive for receipts.

DayCount.description: Day-count conventions of the 2006 ISDA Definitions, section 4.16.

oneOf.description: Actual/Actual (ISDA), §4.16(b): days in leap years / 366 + other days / 365.

30/360 (Bond Basis), §4.16(f): day 31 becomes 30; the end day 31 becomes 30 only if the
start day is 30 or 31.

cash_flows.description: Dated cash flows, in any order; at least one positive and one negative amount.

compounding.description: Compounding of the returned rate. Default: `annual` (ECMA-376 XIRR).

day_count.description: Day count for the time between dates. Default: `act_365_fixed` (ECMA-376 XIRR).

guess.description:
Starting point for Newton's method, annual decimal fraction in the compounding of the
result: the guess per compounding period must be greater than -1 (-100%), so greater
than -1 with annual compounding and no bound with continuous compounding. Default: 0.10
(ECMA-376 XIRR).
